items.title: How the 4 New AI Models Change How You Work
items.summary: Summer used to be when things slowed down. Not anymore. NLW walks through the four models that landed this week — GPT Live, Grok 4.5, Cognition's SWE 1.7, and GPT-5.6 Sol — and argues that the competition has quietly stopped being about raw intelligence and started being about interaction patterns, efficiency, and how you actually get work done.
